name: publish_app
description: Publish the app to production — call for the first publish, to publish again after changes the user wants live, and to set up a custom domain. Omit domain and the user gets the publish form instead (nothing is published until they press Publish on it; to publish a live app again without the form, pass domain_type 'floot_subdomain' and its current subdomain). Pass mobile: true whenever the user mentions iOS, Android, TestFlight, App Store, Google Play, or a mobile/native app — with no store account connected that returns a Connect card; with one connected it publishes with the store builds attached. When the project takes payments and its owner has not finished Stripe setup, the publish is refused and a Set up payments card is returned (nothing published): tell the owner to click the button on the card and finish Stripe setup, then call publish_app again. Same for shipping: when the project uses Floot Shipping and its owner has not connected Shippo, the publish is refused and a Connect Shippo card is returned (nothing published): tell the owner to click it and connect Shippo, then call publish_app again. publish_app always publishes live (web, and the mobile app when it is built; payments in Stripe live mode) — never ask the user test or live. Mobile test builds are started by the user on floot.com. Read get_guides('publishing') for modes, inputs, and statuses before your first call.

add_another.description: custom_domain only: the project ALREADY has a custom domain and the user has explicitly asked for an ADDITIONAL one. Without it, a custom_domain call on a project that already has domains returns those domains instead of opening the wizard — so a user whose domain is already connected is told so rather than sent to add it again.

domain.description: floot_subdomain only: subdomain label (lowercase, digits, hyphens, max 40). Omit to show the user the publish form instead; on a published app a different subdomain is refused (unpublish_app first, confirming with the user). Ignored for custom_domain — the wizard collects the domain.

domain_type.description: Omit for the floot subdomain (shows the publish form in the editor when domain is omitted). 'custom_domain' for domain setup — a paid-plan feature (get_publish_status reports `paid`); it fails for free accounts.

include_made_with_floot.description: false removes the 'Made with Floot' badge (paid plans only — fails for free accounts). Omit to keep the current setting.

mobile.description: Set true whenever the request mentions iOS, Android, TestFlight, App Store, Google Play, Play Store, a native or mobile app, or a phone build — they all mean a mobile build. No store account connected → returns a Connect card (nothing published). Connected → publishes the web app with the store builds attached; the job completes when the web build is live. Omitted on a live app follows the project's saved setting: on plans with unlimited app builds that setting decides (mobile switched off stays web-only); on metered plans omitted always means web-only, and true spends one of a small monthly allowance (the remaining count comes back in the result) — read get_publish_status for the plan and allowance first. Passing true or false also updates the saved setting; omitting leaves it alone.
